themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents performing research tasks autonomously or with minimal human intervention, including exploration, data analysis, and task execution.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist in writing, debugging, and generating code, impacting software development and research workflows.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered platforms and software designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles related to AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, aiding comprehension and efficiency.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to analyze and interpret user feedback, comments, and reviews to gauge sentiment and identify user needs.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Describes comprehensive AI systems and environments built to facilitate and manage research activities, often integrating multiple AI capabilities.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles focused on how AI is specifically applied to enhance or transform the processes within design and research disciplines.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Covers articles that compare, review, or evaluate the effectiveness and usefulness of various AI tools in UX and research contexts.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that directly compare and contrast different AI research tools based on features, performance, or usability.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is changing job roles, skill requirements, and the overall employment landscape within research and related fields.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
